fitAgainstVentedDryer.rationale: All six ingested dryer procedures map to vented_dryer functional domains: heat_source (electric element or gas ignitor/valve), drive_motor, exhaust_path/blower vent restriction, thermal protection via cycling thermostats and safety fuse, door authorization. Mechanical timer realizes control_board/hmi_control/drying_control at platform overlay — analogous to CG-11 gas range realizing electric_range control domains with different physical implementation. No sealed moisture rejection, no heat-pump thermal system, no exhaust-path omission.

rejectedSuperficialDivergences.observation: No electronic control_board or display codes
rejectedSuperficialDivergences.rejection: Mechanical timer is implementation of drying_control — not missing canonical domain

rejectedSuperficialDivergences.observation: Thermostat auto-dry instead of electronic moisture sensor
rejectedSuperficialDivergences.rejection: vented_dryer moisture termination can be thermostat- or sensor-based at platform layer

fitAgainstAioLaundryCombo.rationale: GUD27 is unitized stacked washer+dryer with separate sections and manual load transfer. No integrated_laundry_orchestration, no single drum, no wash→dry mode transition on shared controller. aio_laundry_combo is explicitly the wrong host family.

fitAgainstHeatPumpDryer.rationale: Vented exhaust architecture — no refrigerant loop, no sealed_moisture_rejection_path

washerSectionAnalysis.rationale: Washer section is mechanical with zero ingested OEM electronic test procedures. Wizard template already decomposes washer_section vs dryer_section. Host family (likely top_load_washer mechanical variant) can be resolved when/if washer service manual is ingested — does not require stacked_laundry_center.json canonical graph.
washerSectionAnalysis.recommendedRouting: stacked_laundry wizard → washer_section uses washer family overlay; dryer_section routes to vented_dryer

composedDecompositionHypothesis.hypothesis: stacked_laundry_center = vented_dryer (dry section) + existing washer contract (wash section) + cabinet shared_power only
composedDecompositionHypothesis.reason: Dry section proven variant of vented_dryer. No cross-section functional coupling beyond shared power. No AIO-style orchestration.

integrationAnalysis.conclusion: Cabinet integration does not add functional domains beyond what decomposed washer+dryer contracts already cover

architecturalDisposition.note: Template-level section decomposition — not a blind union graph like aio_laundry_combo
